summary_en: On November 10, 2026, the company executed a block purchase of 110,000 shares at 1,122 yen per share via N-NET3 off-market trading, for a total of 143 million yen, representing 1.72% of issued shares excluding treasury stock.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Market Trading (N-NET3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, the board of directors of Bunkeido Co., Ltd. resolved to execute a block purchase of treasury stock through N-NET3 off-market trading. The company placed a buy order on November 10, 2026, at 8:45 a.m. at the Nagoya Stock Exchange's fixed price of 1,122 yen per share, the closing price of that date. The purchase was limited to the trading time window specified.

The company acquired up to 110,000 shares for a total amount not exceeding 143 million yen, representing 1.72% of issued shares excluding treasury stock as of October 31, 2026 (6,378,322 shares outstanding). The execution was conducted as a contingent block trade, meaning buy orders were matched against sell orders that had been placed for this specific transaction. Results were published after the trading session closed at 8:45 a.m.

The company stated that this purchase was undertaken as part of flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the operating environment. There was a possibility that the full amount or a portion might not be executed depending on market conditions, though the intended share count would not be changed.
